summary_en: Interim dividend increased to 70 yen per share (50 yen ordinary + 20 yen special anniversary dividend) from prior guidance of 50 yen, raising full-year dividend forecast to 120 yen per share from 100 yen. The special 20 yen dividend commemorates the company's 80th founding anniversary on July 1, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Dividend of Surplus (80th Founding Anniversary Commemorative Dividend)
translation_en_brief:
On November 11, 2026, Sankyo Kasei Corporation's Board of Directors resolved to pay an interim dividend of 70 yen per share, effective November 30, 2026, with a record date of September 30, 2026. This comprises an ordinary dividend of 50 yen per share and a special 20 yen per share commemorative dividend. The interim dividend was increased from the previous guidance of 50 yen per share.

The company stated the reason for the special dividend is to express gratitude to shareholders for their support as the company marks its 80th founding anniversary on July 1, 2026.

As a result of this interim dividend increase, the company's full-year dividend forecast has been raised to 120 yen per share from the previous guidance of 100 yen per share, representing a 20 yen increase from prior-year results of 100 yen per share. The source of funds is retained earnings.
